notes:
Lead: Mateo (founder, ex-Stripe infra). Building an in-app assistant to answer product questions & suggest contextual tips inside app. Key points from call:
- Very latency sensitive: "aiming for p50 <100ms"; p95 can be higher but UX wants streaming typing.
- Wants hosted API to avoid infra ops for now; will consider Dedicated later if volume/SLAs require.
- Tried free credits; POC integrated streaming endpoint but had trouble wiring SSE client; asked for a minimal JS example.
- Cost sensitivity: small team, expects 10k-50k monthly messages; concerned about per-token spend for long contexts. Asking about prefix caching and automatic KV caching.
- Security: needs SOC2 attestation, SSO for internal access, audit logs. Data residency not strict (US), retention policy: prefers 30 days for raw transcripts.
- Quote from Mateo: "We need the assistant to feel native — streaming is non-negotiable. If latency is good and we can control cost, we can move fast."
- AE impressions: good fit for hosted_api self-serve; SP tier SMB. Next: send streaming SDK snippits + recommended model/quantization profiles for cost/latency tradeoffs, offer two-week extended credits to complete POC.
- Internal note: follow up with engineering playbook link and a small sample repo (JS + React) showing SSE -> Redwood streaming + prefix cache example.
additional_notes_short: Inbound SMB; self-serve first, likely convert to paid within 1-2 quarters if POC shows good latency + cost. Wants demo of cost controls (batching/caching) and streaming SDK.
